services.name: Premium Pull Through 30/20 Amp
services.desc: People come to Shelter Cove because they’ve got an appetite for adventure. But while they’re here, they work up an appetite for a whole lot more than that. That’s why Hook & Talon serves up great big portions of the greatest camp foods around. From fried green beans and mozzarella sticks to cheeseburgers and BLTs, our on-site café helps you tackle hunger so you can get back to your tackle box. If you’re staying with us during the summer, do your tastebuds a favor and swing on by for lunch or dinner offering our full menu. For the winter, we offer fresh-made pizzas only, a perfect way to satisfy your hunger after a great day of winter fun. Hook & Talon serves up big portions and bigger

services.name: PCT Studio Cabin
services.desc: In this cozy studio cabin, you’ll find that electric heat and a gas fireplace have a way of making the great outdoors even greater. With a queen-sized bed, a full kitchen and a breakfast bar, it has everything you need to rest up and eat well. With a barbecue grill, a picnic table and a wood fire pit, it helps you enjoy some outstanding outdoor dining. And with a front porch, a fantastic view of Odell Lake and a private dock, it makes getting out on the water extraordinarily easy. Whether you choose to bring all your own supplies or rely on our on-site convenience store to gear up, you’ll feel well equipped to live lake life to its fullest in this cabin.
